name: np_car_porsche
character: Porsche flat-six on a wet road at night: a firing-frequency pulse train through the body that follows the rpm through its gears, tyre hiss and spray under it, a squeal at each corner and pops when the throttle lifts; it dives in the slow motion.
note: f0 is the firing frequency rpm x 6 / 120 (45.0 Hz at 900 rpm idle, 440 Hz at the 8800 rpm redline); the speed profile (km/h) and the gear choice are in cars.py; road speed is 2 pi r rpm / (60 G). ESTIMATE: gear ratios, final drive, tyre radius, speed profile, formants and levels are starting values; no recording of this car was measured
